**Rename:** I used `git mv`, so Git shows it as a rename (`R  src/utils/strings.js -> src/utils/text.js`) and the file's history is kept.

**Imports updated:**
- `/work/notes-api/src/routes/notes.js`: `'../utils/strings.js'` → `'../utils/text.js'`
- `/work/notes-api/src/legacy/report.js`: `'../utils/strings.js'` → `'../utils/text.js'`
- `/work/notes-api/src/utils/slugify.js`: `'./strings.js'` → `'./text.js'`

A search found no other references to the old filename. The changes are staged and modified but not committed.
